method: Independent dimensional formulas and decimal arithmetic, written before candidate queries. These are usage cases, not specialist panels.

pump_power.assumptions: steady incompressible flow, no pipe friction; stated overall efficiency

spring_work.assumptions: linear spring; both quantities are extensions

spring_force.assumptions: linear spring; final length minus unstretched length

heat_endpoints.assumptions: constant given specific heat, no phase change or loss

battery_roles.assumptions: constant 100 W load; 500 W inverter rating is capacity constraint, not load

battery_invalid.reason: Conversion efficiency must lie between zero and one for this energy budget; reject 120%.

temperature_interval.assumptions: interval, not absolute temperature; no offset

dimension_mismatch.reason: Length and mass are distinct dimensions; no conversion without additional model data.
